user_query: I want to surprise my company employees with a team-building activity. Provide me with a playlist of motivational songs from the Billboard 200 Albums of all time. Also, find a Soundcloud playlist that promotes teamwork and collaboration.

TaskList.description: Retrieve the top motivational songs from the Billboard 200 Albums of all time.
Create a playlist of the retrieved motivational songs.
Search for a Soundcloud playlist that promotes teamwork and collaboration.
Compile both playlists into a single document for distribution to employees.
